Conversely column-stochastic perturbations y+epsilon h_i with independent zero-sum h_i and weighted zero mean provide s independent nonnegative columns of norm 1, extendable to an invertible contraction. For linfty, an output modulus-one coordinate forces its row to vanish at every input coordinate of modulus below one; invertibility forces r(y)<=r(x). Conversely exact active rows and epsilon-corrected remaining rows give a block triangular invertible map with row l1 norms <=1. Faces have real dimensions s-1 on l1 or delta_F(n-r) on linfty, delta_R=1, delta_C=2; the support strata are open and dense in the relative sphere and form precisely n ordered classes. Complex matrices use xbar_i at active coordinates and phase-normalized isometries; positive real constructions extend over C.
